mapper.select: select count(1) as total, coalesce(sum(case when status = 'done' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as done_count, coalesce(sum(case when priority = 'urgent' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as urgent_count, avg(case when status = 'done' then timestampdiff(minute, created_at, updated_at) / 60 end) as avg_done_hours from biz_ticket where
select date_format(created_at, '%m-%d') as name, count(1) as value from biz_ticket where group by date(created_at), date_format(created_at, '%m-%d') order by date(created_at)
select date_format(updated_at, '%m-%d') as name, count(1) as value from biz_ticket where status = 'done' and group by date(updated_at), date_format(updated_at, '%m-%d') order by date(updated_at)
select status as name, count(1) as value from biz_ticket where group by status
select priority as name, avg(timestampdiff(minute, created_at, updated_at) / 60) as hours from biz_ticket where group by priority
